title: Everybody's Astrology
author: Magnus Jensen
description: Everybody's Astrology by Magnus Jensen, an early twentieth-century popular introduction to astrology, here from an Internet Archive scan. Written for the general reader, it explains in plain language the signs of the zodiac and the character traits, talents, health tendencies and compatibilities associated with being born under each, the influence of the planets, and simple methods for interpreting a birth chart. It belongs to the wave of accessible astrology handbooks published in Britain and America in the early twentieth century, when astrology spread to a mass audience through magazines and almanacs. The text, produced by optical character recognition, contains some errors.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/everybodysastrol00jens).
